incidents.title: Stale menus in SG — XYZFood merchants showing yesterday's items
incidents.customer_impact: Subset of SG XYZFood merchants showed previous-day items and prices during dinner peak. Ops received merchant complaints via the hotline. No confirmed MY impact.
incidents.trigger: Batch job overrun; storefront served a stale snapshot for ~3 hours.
incidents.immediate_mitigation: Re-ran batch for affected merchant shard; forced cache purge.
incidents.root_cause_hypothesis: Nightly batch duration now exceeds the window we assumed. This is the class of failure Harbor is supposed to remove.
incidents.notes: Resolved as an incident. No Harbor Jira risk or follow-up was filed. Batch pipeline is still the production path for SG.
